```{r}
# Function GO analysis : 
# http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/topGO/inst/doc/topGO.pdf
# Adapted to be more generic
########################
dag_geneID2GO<-function(data=NA,
                        subgenome=NA,
                        column_id=NA,
                        column_go=NA,
                        last
  ) {
  
  if (length(data)==1){
    x<-functional_annotation[,c(13,12)]
  
    ################################################
    # Remove ChrUn annotations to avoid biases in GO 
    x<-x[!x$Simp.Gene.ID %like% "TraesCSU",]
    ################################################
  
    if (!is.na(subgenome)){
      x<-x[x$Simp.Gene.ID %like% paste0("TraesCS[0-9]",subgenome),]
    }
    
    x$`GO.IDs.via.Interpro`<-gsub(";",",",x$`GO.IDs.via.Interpro`,perl=TRUE)
    x$`GO.IDs.via.Interpro`<-gsub(" ","",x$`GO.IDs.via.Interpro`,perl=TRUE)
    
    # Split delimited strings in column and insert as row
    x<-x %>% separate_rows(GO.IDs.via.Interpro,sep=",")
    
    x<-x[x$`GO.IDs.via.Interpro`!=""] # Select only genes with GO annotation
  } else {
    x<-data
    colnames(x)<-c(column_id,column_go)
    x$GO<-gsub(";",",",x$GO,perl=TRUE)
    x$GO<-gsub(" ","",x$GO,perl=TRUE)
    
    # Split delimited strings in column and insert as row
    x<-x %>% separate_rows(GO,sep=",")
    
    x<-x[x$GO %like% "GO",] # Select only genes with GO annotation
  }
  colnames(x)<-c(column_id,column_go)
  
  write.table(x,file="temp.txt",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names = FALSE,col.names = FALSE)
  
  geneID2GO <- readMappings(file = "temp.txt")
  GO2geneID <- inverseList(geneID2GO)
  geneID2GO <- inverseList(GO2geneID) # Added to fix the list because we need grouped GOs per gene rather than one GO per line with repeated geneIDs. Otherwise it only takes first GO per gene.

    
  # Adapt to FGN_test
  if (1==1){
    # GO:0003674 is the MF root.
    # GO:0005575 is the CC root.
    # GO:0008150 is the BP root.
    
    MF<-GOMFOFFSPRING$"GO:0003674"
    CC<-GOCCOFFSPRING$"GO:0005575"
    BP<-GOBPOFFSPRING$"GO:0008150" 
    
    MF_x<-x[x$GO %in% MF,]
    CC_x<-x[x$GO %in% CC,]
    BP_x<-x[x$GO %in% BP,]
    
    MF_x[,"Ontology"]<-"MF"
    CC_x[,"Ontology"]<-"CC"
    BP_x[,"Ontology"]<-"BP"
    
    tableGoGenes<-rbind (MF_x,CC_x,BP_x)
    colnames(tableGoGenes)<-c("GENENAME","GO","ONTOLOGY")

    tableGoGenesSplit <- split(tableGoGenes, tableGoGenes$ONTOLOGY) # Split by ontology
    tableGoGenesSplit <- tableGoGenesSplit[which(paste("GO_", names(tableGoGenesSplit), sep="") %in% c("GO_BP","GO_MF","GO_CC"))] # Select the requested ontologies
    
    geneID2GO_x <- lapply(tableGoGenesSplit, function(x) split(as.character(x$GO),x[,"GENENAME"]))
    GO2geneID_x <- lapply(tableGoGenesSplit, function(x) split(x[,"GENENAME"], as.character(x$GO)))
  }
  return(list(geneID2GO=geneID2GO,
              GO2geneID=GO2geneID,
              geneID2GO_x=geneID2GO_x,
              GO2geneID_x=GO2geneID_x,
              tableGoGenes=tableGoGenes,
              tableGoGenesSplit=tableGoGenesSplit
  ))
}


dag_GO<-function(data,
         name=NA, # Analysis name
         ontology="BP", # Biological Process, Cellular Component, Molecular Function
         folder=folder, # Folder name to save results
         geneID2GO=NULL,
         genesUniverse=NULL,
         last
  ) {

  if (is.null(geneID2GO)){
    x<-dag_geneID2GO()
    geneID2GO<-x$geneID2GO
    GO2geneID<-x$GO2geneID
    geneID2GO_x<-x$geneID2GO_x
    GO2geneID_x<-x$GO2geneID_x
  }

  # Adapt geneid column to Geneid if necessary
  if (sum(colnames(data) %in% "geneid")==1){names(data)[names(data) == 'geneid'] <- "Geneid"}
  
  # Gene Universe
  if (is.null(genesUniverse)){
    genesUniverse <- unique(names(geneID2GO))
  }
   
  # Genes of interest
  myInterestingGenes <- data$Geneid
  geneList<-myInterestingGenes
  geneListvector <- factor(as.integer(genesUniverse %in% myInterestingGenes))
  names(geneListvector) <- genesUniverse
  str(geneListvector)
  
  # Construct GO object
  GOdata_BP <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "BP", allGenes = geneListvector, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO)
  GOdata_CC <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "CC", allGenes = geneListvector, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO)
  GOdata_MF <- new("topGOdata", ontology = "MF", allGenes = geneListvector, annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO)

  # Recover all genes per GO (including "back progagation") 
  tempBP = genesInTerm(GOdata_BP)
  tempBP <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tempBP, as.data.frame))
  tempBP$GO<-row.names(tempBP)
  colnames(tempBP)<-c("Col1","Col2")
  tempBP$Col2 <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+","",tempBP$Col2,perl=TRUE)
  tempBPgene2GO <- tempBP %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col1) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col2 = paste(Col2, collapse = ","))
  tempBPGO2gene <- tempBP %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col2) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col1 = paste(Col1, collapse = ","))
  tempBPgene2GO <- as.data.table(tempBPgene2GO)
  colnames(tempBPgene2GO)<-c("Gene","GO")
  tempBPGO2gene <- as.data.table(tempBPGO2gene)
  colnames(tempBPGO2gene)<-c("GO","Gene")
  
  tempCC<-genesInTerm(GOdata_CC)
  tempCC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tempCC, as.data.frame))
  tempCC$Col2<-row.names(tempCC)
  colnames(tempCC)<-c("Col1","Col2")
  tempCC$Col2 <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+","",tempCC$Col2,perl=TRUE)
  tempCCgene2GO <- tempCC %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col1) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col2 = paste(Col2, collapse = ","))
  tempCCGO2gene <- tempCC %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col2) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col1 = paste(Col1, collapse = ","))
  tempCCgene2GO <- as.data.table(tempCCgene2GO)
  colnames(tempCCgene2GO)<-c("Gene","GO")
  tempCCGO2gene <- as.data.table(tempCCGO2gene)
  colnames(tempCCGO2gene)<-c("GO","Gene")
  
  tempMF<-genesInTerm(GOdata_MF)
  tempMF <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tempMF, as.data.frame))
  tempMF$Col2<-row.names(tempMF)
  colnames(tempMF)<-c("Col1","Col2")
  tempMF$Col2 <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+","",tempMF$Col2,perl=TRUE)
  tempMFgene2GO <- tempMF %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col1) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col2 = paste(Col2, collapse = ","))
  tempMFGO2gene <- tempMF %>%
                    dplyr::group_by(Col2) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(Col1 = paste(Col1, collapse = ","))
  tempMFgene2GO <- as.data.table(tempMFgene2GO)
  colnames(tempMFgene2GO)<-c("Gene","GO")
  tempMFGO2gene <- as.data.table(tempMFGO2gene)
  colnames(tempMFGO2gene)<-c("GO","Gene")
  
  write.table(tempBPgene2GO,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_BP_gene2GO.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(tempBPGO2gene,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_BP_GO2gene.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(tempCCgene2GO,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_CC_gene2GO.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(tempCCGO2gene,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_CC_GO2gene.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(tempMFgene2GO,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_MF_gene2GO.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(tempMFGO2gene,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_MF_GO2gene.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  

  # Calculate the stats
  test.stat_clasfi <- new("classicCount", testStatistic = GOFisherTest, name = "Fisher test")
  test.stat_clasks <- new("classicScore", testStatistic = GOKSTest, name = "KS tests")
  test.stat_elim <- new("elimScore", testStatistic = GOKSTest, name = "Fisher test", cutOff = 0.01)
  test.stat_weight <- new("weightCount", testStatistic = GOFisherTest, name = "Fisher test", sigRatio = "ratio")

  resultFisher_BP <- getSigGroups(GOdata_BP, test.stat_clasfi)
  resultKS_BP <- getSigGroups(GOdata_BP, test.stat_clasks)
  resultElim_BP <- getSigGroups(GOdata_BP, test.stat_elim)
  resultWeight_BP <- getSigGroups(GOdata_BP, test.stat_weight)

  resultFisher_CC <- getSigGroups(GOdata_CC, test.stat_clasfi)
  resultKS_CC <- getSigGroups(GOdata_CC, test.stat_clasks)
  resultElim_CC <- getSigGroups(GOdata_CC, test.stat_elim)
  resultWeight_CC <- getSigGroups(GOdata_CC, test.stat_weight)

  resultFisher_MF <- getSigGroups(GOdata_MF, test.stat_clasfi)
  resultKS_MF <- getSigGroups(GOdata_MF, test.stat_clasks)
  resultElim_MF <- getSigGroups(GOdata_MF, test.stat_elim)
  resultWeight_MF <- getSigGroups(GOdata_MF, test.stat_weight)


  # Fisher: For each GO category, compares the expected number of significant genes at random to the observed number of significant genes, and get a p-value. Significant genes: hard cut-off based on p-value or score
  # Classic: Each node is tested independently
  # Elim: Testing from bottom up (starting from most specific node). If tested significant in a child node, these genes would not contribute to parental node
  # Weight: A weightinig scheme for genes contribution towards neighboring term
  # KS: Kolmogorov-Smirnov. Needs a DE gene list + pvalues (or score). The KS test Compares the distribution of gene p-values expected at random to the observed distribution of the gene p-values to arrive at a probability. No cutoff is needed. Input file include all genes with p-value and score
  allRes_BP <- GenTable(GOdata_BP, classic = resultFisher_BP, KS = resultKS_BP, elim=resultElim_BP, weight = resultWeight_BP, orderBy = "weight", ranksOf = "classic", topNodes = length(usedGO(GOdata_BP))) #topNodes = 200)
  allRes_CC <- GenTable(GOdata_CC, classic = resultFisher_CC, KS = resultKS_CC, elim=resultElim_CC, weight = resultWeight_CC, orderBy = "weight", ranksOf = "classic",  topNodes = length(usedGO(GOdata_CC))) #topNodes = 200)
  allRes_MF <- GenTable(GOdata_MF, classic = resultFisher_MF, KS = resultKS_MF, elim=resultElim_MF, weight = resultWeight_MF, orderBy = "weight", ranksOf = "classic",  topNodes = length(usedGO(GOdata_MF))) #topNodes = 200)

  allRes_BP$Significant_expected_ratio<-allRes_BP$Significant/allRes_BP$Expected
  allRes_CC$Significant_expected_ratio<-allRes_CC$Significant/allRes_CC$Expected
  allRes_MF$Significant_expected_ratio<-allRes_MF$Significant/allRes_MF$Expected
  
  saveRDS(GOdata_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_data_",name,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(GOdata_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_data_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(GOdata_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_data_",name,"_MF.Rds"))
  
  saveRDS(allRes_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(allRes_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(allRes_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_MF.Rds"))
  
  write.table(allRes_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_BP.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(allRes_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_CC.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  write.table(allRes_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_allRes_",name,"_MF.txt"),col.names=TRUE)
  
  saveRDS(resultFisher_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultFisher_",name,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultKS_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultKS_",name,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultElim_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultElim_",name,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultWeight_BP,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultWeight_",name,"_BP.Rds"))

  saveRDS(resultFisher_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultFisher_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultKS_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultKS_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultElim_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultElim_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultWeight_CC,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultWeight_",name,"_CC.Rds"))
  
  saveRDS(resultFisher_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultFisher_",name,"_MF.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultKS_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultKS_",name,"_MF.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultElim_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultElim_",name,"_MF.Rds"))
  saveRDS(resultWeight_MF,file=paste0(folder,"GO_resultWeight_",name,"_MF.Rds"))


  printGraph(GOdata_BP, resultWeight_BP, firstSigNodes = 10, resultFisher_BP, fn.prefix = paste0(folder,"GO_",name,"_BP"), useInfo = "def", pdfSW = TRUE)
  printGraph(GOdata_CC, resultWeight_CC, firstSigNodes = 10, resultFisher_CC, fn.prefix = paste0(folder,"GO_",name,"_CC"), useInfo = "def", pdfSW = TRUE)
  printGraph(GOdata_MF, resultWeight_MF, firstSigNodes = 10, resultFisher_MF, fn.prefix = paste0(folder,"GO_",name,"_MF"), useInfo = "def", pdfSW = TRUE)
  
  
  return(list(allRes_BP=allRes_BP,
              allRes_CC=allRes_CC,
              allRes_MF=allRes_MF
  ))
}
```

```{r}

dag_readfiles_modified <- function(files, readsfolder=NULL, readsprefix=NULL, readssufix=NULL,correspondance=NULL,consolidateprojectreads=NULL,gene_coordinates=NULL,reduceprojectreads=NULL,columns_or_file_names="file") {
  #l <- 1
  for (l in 1:length(files)){
    i=files[l]

    j=""  
    for (fol in readsfolder){
      for (pre in readsprefix){
        for (suf in readssufix){
          t=paste0(fol,pre,i,suf)
          if (file.exists(t)){
            j=t
          }
          else (print(paste0("Error: files ",t," doesn't exists")))
        } 
      }      
    }

    y=fread(j,header=TRUE,sep="\t",na.strings=".")#,skip=1) 
    colnames(y)[1:6]<-c("Geneid","Chr","Start","End","Strand","Length")

    ##########################################
    # Filter out here once for all ChrUn genes
    y<-y[!y$Chr %like% "chrUn",]
    ##########################################
    #ll <- 7
    for (ll in 7:length(colnames(y))){
      lll<-colnames(y)[ll]
      colnames(y)[ll]<-"sample"
      if (l==1 & ll==7){
        counts<-y[,c("Geneid","sample")]
        genes<-y[,c("Geneid","Length")]
        colnames(y)[ll]<-lll
      } else {
        counts<-merge(counts,y[,c("Geneid","sample")], by="Geneid",all=TRUE);counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0
        if (y[,c("Geneid")] %in% genes[,c("Geneid")]){ # If we have new genes. i.e. reading samples from another a bam with only subgenome D and another from a bam with subgenome ABD
          genes<-merge(genes,y[!y$Geneid %in% genes$Geneid,c("Geneid","Length")], by=c("Geneid","Length"),all=TRUE)
        }
        colnames(y)[ll]<-lll
      }
      if (columns_or_file_names %in% "file"){
        i<-correspondance[correspondance$file_name %in% i , "correspondance"] # This allow to fix samples problems like i.e. Langdon 500T1 250T2
        names(counts)[names(counts) == 'sample'] <- as.character(i$correspondance) # I had to do this and use an intermediate 'sample' name because merge doesn't want to use a variable i directly. Need to check this in the future
      }
      else if (columns_or_file_names %in% "columns"){
        print(lll)
        i<-correspondance$correspondance[correspondance$file_name %in% lll]
        names(counts)[names(counts) == "sample"] <- as.character(i) # I had to do this and use an intermediate 'sample' name because merge doesn't want to use a variable i directly. Need to check this in the future
      }
    }
  }

  # Used it we have multiple copies of the same data. Developed to take into account original unsuccessful sequencing of brachy as well as the redone sequencing
  if (length(consolidateprojectreads)!=0){ 
    temp<-as.data.frame(counts)
    rownames(temp)<-temp[,"Geneid"]
    temp<-temp[,!colnames(temp) %in% "Geneid"]
    
    colnames(temp)<-gsub(consolidateprojectreads,"",colnames(temp),perl=TRUE)
    temp2<-unique(colnames(temp))
  
    temp<-t(rowsum(t(temp), group = colnames(temp), na.rm = T)) # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/35626945/row-wise-sum-of-values-grouped-by-columns-with-same-name
    temp<-as.data.frame(temp)
    temp[,"Geneid"]<-rownames(temp)
    temp<-as.data.table(temp)
    PROJECT_files<-temp2
    temp2<-c("Geneid",temp2)
    counts<-  temp[,..temp2]
  }
  
  # Changes samples names
  x<-colnames(counts[,2:ncol(counts)])
  y<-correspondance[correspondance %in% x,c("correspondance","new_name")]
  t<-y[match(x, y$correspondance),]$new_name
  colnames(counts)<-c("Geneid",t)
  t<-sort(t)
  t<-c("Geneid",t)
  counts<-counts[,..t]
  #
  projectreads<-dag_readsummary(counts=counts,lengths=genes,files=PROJECT_files,correspondance_files=correspondance)
  if (length(gene_coordinates)!=0){
    projectreads$genes<-unique(merge(projectreads$genes,gene_coordinates[Gene %in% projectreads$genes$Geneid,c("Chromosome","Gene")],by.x="Geneid",by.y="Gene"))
  }
  if (length(reduceprojectreads)!=0){
    projectreads <- projectreads[, colnames(projectreads[,colnames(projectreads) %like% reduceprojectreads]) , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
  }
  rownames(projectreads$genes)<-projectreads$genes$Geneid
 
  # Make sure order of genes is the same in projectreads$genes is the same as in projectreads$counts. Otherwise we can have problems later when filtering with keep
  projectreads$genes<-projectreads$genes[sort(projectreads$genes$Geneid),]
  projectreads$counts<-projectreads$counts[sort(projectreads$genes$Geneid),]
  
  return(projectreads)
}
```

```{r}
# Parameters

filterminlib=3 # Minimum number of libraries per treatment where "filtermin" must be true.
padjusted=0.01
dag_withnames=1 # 1=Group_1; 2=Group_2; 4=Group_3; 8=Group_4; 0=None; 3=1+2 ; 5=1+4, etc... 
DEGonly=0 #0 = NO, so it will produce PCAs and so on, 1 = YES, and it will only compare treatments pairwise and generate all the plots.
runedgeR=1 #0 = NO, and it will only run preliminary analyses, 1 = YES and all the analyses in edgeR will be performed.
dag_plot_pairs_heatmap="no"
filter_low=filter 
dag_incompatible = c("") # Incompatible sample to avoid analysis during complex interactions. I.e.: "L","T","C0","C2"
dag_simple=1 # Calculate simple interactions
dag_complex=0  # Calculate complex interactions like (4E)-(4L-5E-5L) or (4E_18)-(4L_18-5E_18-5L_18) or (4E_18-4E_12)-(4L_18-4L_12-5E_18-5E_12-5L_18-5L_12)
#dag_subgenomes= c("A","B","D")
dag_subgenomes= c("none")
dag_model_method="QLF" # LRT , QLF or both
dag_contrast1=0
dag_contrast2=1
dag_contrast3=1
dag_contrast4=0
dag_already_lib_normalized=0

dag_filter_contrast=0 # 1 = Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "-" in the first part. I.e.: complex or (A_100-A_250) and leave only single species comparisons i.e. (A_100-A_250)
                      # 2 = Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "_" but no "-" in the first part. I.e.: complex like (C0_100)-(L_100-R_100)
                      # 3 = Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "_" and one "-" in the first part. I.e.: complex like (5E_18-5E_12)-(5L_18-5L_12)
                      # 4 = Option 1 + 2
```

```{r}
if (1==1){
    for (prefix in unique(c(dag_complete_prefix_2,dag_prefix))){
      for (subgenome in dag_subgenomes){
        if (subgenome=="none" | (
          prefix %like% "^[a-zA-Z]*_[0-9]"  | # Because if I have already splitted by subgenomes we don't need to do it again
          (subgenome=="A" & prefix %like% "^.*_A_") |
          (subgenome=="B" & prefix %like% "^.*_B_") |
          (subgenome=="D" & prefix %like% "^.*_D_") )){
      
          names<-dag_folders_name(prefix,dag_prefix2,subgenome,filtermin=filtermin,filterminlib=filterminlib,filter_low=filter_low,padjusted=padjusted)

            } else{

            }

            } else {

          if (runedgeR==1){
            # Calculate now all the DEGs 
            model<-dag_design_and_contrasts(data=data,contrast1=dag_contrast1,contrast2=dag_contrast2,contrast3=dag_contrast3,contrast4=dag_contrast4,folder=folder,name=name,incompatible = dag_incompatible,simple=dag_simple,complex=dag_complex) # Another option would be to create manually the design and all the desired contrasts. This works as default model to compare species(contrast1) or stade(contrast2) vs condition(contrast3) or replicate(contrast4)

            if (dag_filter_contrast==1){ # Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "-". I.e.: complex or (A_100-A_250)

            # for (y in rownames(model$used)){

            #   #model$fgroup$sample[model$fgroup$sample %in% c(colnames(x[y,x[y,]==1])),]
            #   #model$fgroup[model$fgroup$sample %in% c(colnames(x[y,x[y,]==1])),]$grp1
            #   if(length(unique(as.character(model$fgroup[model$fgroup$sample %in% c(colnames(x[y,x[y,]==1])),]$grp1)))!=1){x[y,]<-0}
            # }
            # model$used<-x[rowSums(x)!=0,]
            # model$contrasts<-model$contrasts[rownames(x[rowSums(x)!=0,]),]

            x<-model$used
            z<-c("0")
            for (y in rownames(model$used)){
              if (dag_complex==1){
                if (dag_contrast1==1 & dag_contrast2==0){
                  if(y %like% '.*)-'){
                     #print(paste0(y))
                     z<-c(z,y)
                   }
                } else {
                  if(y %like% '.*-.*)-'){
                     #print(paste0(y))
                     z<-c(z,y)
                  }
                }
              } else {
                if (dag_contrast1==1 & dag_contrast2==0){
                   if (!y %like% "-"){
                    z<-c(z,y)
                   }
                } else {
                  if(length(unique(as.character(model$fgroup[model$fgroup$sample %in% c(colnames(x[y,x[y,]==1])),]$grp1)))==1){
                    #print(paste0(y))
                    z<-c(z,y)
                  }
                }
              }
            }
            z<-z[2:length(z)]
            model$used<-model$used[z,]
            model$contrasts<-model$contrasts[z,]


            write.table(model$contrast,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Contrasts_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
            write.table(model$used,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Used_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
          }
            if (dag_filter_contrast==2){ # Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "_" but no "-" in the first part. I.e.: compler like (C0_100)-(L_100-R_100)
              x<-model$used
              z<-c("0")
              for (y in rownames(model$used)){
                if(y %like% '\\([a-zA-Z0-9]+_[a-zA-Z0-9]+\\)-'){
                  z<-c(z,y)
                }
              }
              z<-z[2:length(z)]
              model$used<-model$used[z,]
              model$contrasts<-model$contrasts[z,]
  
              write.table(model$contrast,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Contrasts_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
              write.table(model$used,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Used_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
            }
            if (dag_filter_contrast==3){ # 3 = Filter contrasts to retain only the ones containing a "_" and one "-" in the first part. I.e.: complex like (5E_18-5E_12)-(5L_18-5L_12)
              x<-model$used
              z<-c("0")
              for (y in rownames(model$used)){
                if(y %like% '\\([a-zA-Z0-9]+_[a-zA-Z0-9]+-[a-zA-Z0-9]+_[a-zA-Z0-9]+\\)-'){
                  z<-c(z,y)
                }
              }
              z<-z[2:length(z)]
              model$used<-model$used[z,]
              model$contrasts<-model$contrasts[z,]
  
              write.table(model$contrast,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Contrasts_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
              write.table(model$used,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Used_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
            }
            if (dag_filter_contrast==4){ # Option 1 + 3
              x<-model$used
              z<-c("0")
              for (y in rownames(model$used)){
                if (dag_complex==1){
                  if (dag_contrast1==1 & dag_contrast2==0){
                    if(y %like% '.*)-'){
                       #print(paste0(y))
                       z<-c(z,y)
                     }
                  } else {
                    if(y %like% '.*-.*)-'){
                       #print(paste0(y))
                       z<-c(z,y)
                    }
                  }
                } else {
                  if (dag_contrast1==1 & dag_contrast2==0){
                     if (!y %like% "-"){
                      z<-c(z,y)
                     }
                  } else {
                    if(length(unique(as.character(model$fgroup[model$fgroup$sample %in% c(colnames(x[y,x[y,]==1])),]$grp1)))==1){
                      #print(paste0(y))
                      z<-c(z,y)
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
              z<-z[2:length(z)]
              
              x<-model$used
              zz<-c("0")
              for (y in rownames(model$used)){
                if(y %like% '\\([a-zA-Z0-9]+_[a-zA-Z0-9]+-[a-zA-Z0-9]+_[a-zA-Z0-9]+\\)-'){
                  zz<-c(zz,y)
                }
              }
              zz<-zz[2:length(zz)]
              
              
              model$used<-model$used[c(z,zz),]
              model$contrasts<-model$contrasts[c(z,zz),]
  
  
              write.table(model$contrast,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Contrasts_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
              write.table(model$used,file=paste0(folder,"/edgeR/",name,"/",name,"_Used_",dag_filter_contrast,".txt"))
            }
          
          
           stats<-dag_DE(data=data,name=name,filter=filter,filtermin=filtermin,filterminlib=filterminlib,plot_pairs_heatmap="no",padjusted = padjusted,DEGonly=DEGonly,runedgeR=runedgeR,folder=folder,design=model$design,contrasts=model$contrasts,used=model$used,fgroup=model$fgroup,model_method=dag_model_method,already_lib_normalized=dag_already_lib_normalized)
          }
        }
      }
    }
}
```

Read GO Enrichment results
```{r}
for (all_up_down in c("all","up","down")){
  ls_BP=list()
  ls_CC=list()
  ls_MF=list()
  for (prefix in c(dag_prefix)){
    names<-dag_folders_name(prefix=prefix,prefix2=dag_prefix2,subgenome=subgenome,filtermin=filtermin,filterminlib=filterminlib,filter_low=filter_low,padjusted=padjusted)
    name=names$name
    folder=names$folder
    folderPCA=names$folderPCA
    folderData=names$folderData
    folderUpset=names$folderUpset
    folderedgeR=names$folderedgeR
    folderGO=names$folderGO
    
    # Load everything  
        
    m<-read.table(file=paste0(folderedgeR,name,"/",name,"_Contrasts.txt"),header=T)
    contrasts<-rownames(m)
    contrasts<-contrasts[23]
    
    for (i in contrasts){
      n<-paste0(name,"_",i)
      if (file.exists(paste0(folderedgeR,"/",name,"/data/edgeR_QLF_",all_up_down,"_",n,".Rds"))){
        temp<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderedgeR,"/",name,"/data/edgeR_QLF_",all_up_down,"_",n,".Rds"))
        #temp<-temp$table
        if (all_up_down=="all"){
          t<-temp[temp$FDR<=0.01,]
          name2<-paste0(n,"_all")
        } else if (all_up_down=="up"){
          t<-temp[temp$FDR<=0.01 & temp$logFC>0,]
          name2<-paste0(n,"_up")
        } else if (all_up_down=="down"){
          t<-temp[temp$FDR<=0.01 & temp$logFC<0,]
          name2<-paste0(n,"_down")
        }
              
              
        for (j in c("BP","CC","MF")){
          if (file.exists(paste0(folderGO,"GO_data_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))){
            GOdata<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_data_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))
            resultFisher<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resultFisher_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))
            resultKS<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resultKS_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))
            resultElim<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resultElim_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))
            resultWeight<-readRDS(file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resultWeight_",name2,"_",j,".Rds"))
    
            allRes <- GenTable(GOdata, classic = resultFisher, KS = resultKS, elim=resultElim, weight = resultWeight, orderBy = "weight", ranksOf = "classic", topNodes = length(usedGO(GOdata)))
            if (nrow(allRes)!=0){
              # print(paste0(j," ",nrow(allRes)))
              allRes$temp<-gsub("<","",perl=TRUE,allRes$weight)  # If not, values <1e-30 are coerced as NAs
              allRes$temp<-as.numeric(allRes$temp)  # If not, it is treated as character and values like 1e-5 is ignored
              allRes <- allRes[allRes$temp<0.05,]
              allRes <- allRes[,!colnames(allRes) %in% "temp"]
              assign(paste0(name2,"_GO_",j),allRes)
    
              if (nrow(allRes)!=0){        
                allRes$Name<-name
                allRes$Contrast<-i
            
                # pval <- score(resultFisher);hist(pval, 50, xlab = "p-values")
                # pval <- score(resultKS);hist(pval, 50, xlab = "p-values")
                # pval <- score(resultElim);hist(pval, 50, xlab = "p-values")
                # pval <- score(resultWeight);hist(pval, 50, xlab = "p-values")
            
                if (j=="BP"){ls_BP[[paste0(name,"_",i)]]<-allRes}
                if (j=="CC"){ls_CC[[paste0(name,"_",i)]]<-allRes}
                if (j=="MF"){ls_MF[[paste0(name,"_",i)]]<-allRes}
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  saveRDS(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_BP),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_BP.Rds"))
  saveRDS(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_CC),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_CC.Rds"))
  saveRDS(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_MF),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_MF.Rds"))
  write.table(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_BP),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_BP.txt"),row.names=TRUE,col.names = TRUE)
  write.table(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_CC),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_CC.txt"),row.names=TRUE,col.names = TRUE)
  write.table(do.call(rbind.data.frame, ls_MF),file=paste0(folderGO,"GO_resume_",all_up_down,"_MF.txt"),row.names=TRUE,col.names = TRUE)
}
```
